Job description Please see Dutch vacancy page. Job requirements  Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.  Apply  All done! Your application has been successfully submitted! Keep logistics moving as a Logistics Coordinator in Lelystad. As a Logistics Coordinator, you are organised, communicative and able to stay calm when things change. You enjoy working in a dynamic warehouse environment and know how to keep an overview when priorities shift. You are also comfortable communicating with drivers, carriers and internal teams and represent the organisation professionally at all times. MBO+ level of working and thinking, preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain 1 to 3 years of experience in a logistics, transport or warehouse environment Experience with ERP or WMS systems such as SAP is an advantage Good command of English, both written and spoken Valid driver’s license and own transportation Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a modern logistics environment in Lelystad, where collaboration, accuracy and continuous improvement are key. Monthly salary €2,607 to €3,349 excluding shift allowance 25 vacation days based on a 40 hour work week Option to purchase one extra week of leave and three additional healthy days Company laptop and phone for business and private use Pension plan, discount on gym membership and bike plan, active staff association This is a role in two shifts Functieomschrijving As a Logistics Coordinator, you are responsible for the accurate and efficient handling of transport processes at the Lelystad site. As a Logistics Employee, you will join an international logistics organization specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. At the Lelystad location, a modern warehouse environment is being developed, with automation and technology playing a key role. Together with your colleagues, you will develop efficient ways of working, build strong teams, and create a warehouse operation that is ready for further growth.
